line: Thousands of ink wind lines, computed from the best track, draw Super Typhoon Yagi: the eye opening over the South China Sea, the landfall on Hainan, the spiral coming apart in Vietnam, and a whole week folded into one last line.
line_cn: 几千条从最佳路径算出来的墨色风线，画出超强台风摩羯的一生：在南海睁开风眼，在文昌登陆，在越南散开，一整周最后收成一条线。
uses: Any flow measured against a threshold

transitions: Transitions are camera moves only: blended shot functions, no cuts to black, no dissolves between places, no page turns.
labels: Roles: a CJK serif for names and headings (e.g. Noto Serif SC, 600–700); a book serif with a true italic for English and water names (e.g. Newsreader); a monospace for readings, dates and units (e.g. IBM Plex Mono Medium). All OFL, self-hosted, CJK subset to the characters used.

Text lives in the world: names of seas and regions are printed on the ground plane (italic, letter-spaced); places are pinned with a small ring and a label; readings sit at the end of a leader from the thing measured; legends, curves and the title block are printed cartouches (paper fill, double rule).

Bilingual: one language per line, Chinese above English. Chinese printed on screen is at least 34 px at 1080p, Latin at least 20 px; printed text is sized in world units for the shot where it is read. A crowded table loses a column before its type shrinks.

Subtitles (when there is narration) are printed at the foot of the chart on a soft paper wash, an elliptical fade rather than a box, no outline or shadow: Chinese (CJK serif 600, ~38 px) over English (book italic, ~29 px), centred. Compose every shot so cartouches, readings and labels end above ~900 px and the wash never covers the subject.
motion: 30 fps on ones. Lines never pop, flicker or reorder: every change is continuous in time (field, level weights, fades, the camera).
Strokes run at 60–300 px/s; compress the speed so the fastest stroke moves less than its own length per frame.
Time in the story may run at any rate but never backwards, and is mapped through a monotone curve (no kinks).
Readings roll through real records and land with a sound; legends print row by row; tracks draw on with beads.

native_moves.name: The field organises
native_moves.does: A centre spins up; lines tighten into a spiral and, as the magnitude crosses a threshold, an empty core opens.
native_moves.fits: a whirlpool at a bridge pier; a crowd circling a plaza; a market panic converging on one stock.

native_moves.name: The coast twists the lines
native_moves.does: A moving feature meets fixed ground; lines kink at the shore, slow and turn over land, part round high ground.
native_moves.fits: a river in flood meeting a levee; wind round a skyscraper; traffic meeting a closed junction.

native_moves.name: The ramp crosses a threshold
native_moves.does: Lines change colour exactly where the magnitude enters the next category, and the legend uses the same colours.
native_moves.fits: air-quality bands; speed limits on a road network; heat stress levels.

native_moves.name: Beads on a track
native_moves.does: A dashed path draws on with one bead per record in the category colour and a date every day.
native_moves.fits: a migrating bird; a drifting buoy; a ship's voyage.

native_moves.name: The printed verdict
native_moves.does: A cartouche prints row by row, everything holds, then a pointer climbs and stops on a row that inks in.
native_moves.fits: a building code against measured load; a forecast against what happened; a rating scale.

native_moves.name: The grazing pass
native_moves.does: The camera skims the surface and the strongest lines stream past in the foreground.
native_moves.fits: a tidal race; a ski slope's wind; a jet stream crossing an ocean.

native_moves.name: The field relaxes
native_moves.does: As the driver weakens, spirals open, the core fills, the colour drains back to ink.
native_moves.fits: a storm's decay; a crowd dispersing; a current slackening at the turn of the tide.

score.note: low sustained strings, a single long harmonic, sparse plucks
